svg.title: Managed ACP: acceptance, execution and results
svg.desc: submit returns a resumable receipt; run waits for its result. Acceptance is not completion. After disconnect, use the same identity and taskId for events/get. Cancellation requires checking execution and cleanup; publishing a patch requires renewed authorization and user approval.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif

svg.text: Managed ACP: acceptance, execution and results
